name: amzn-selling-partner-codegen
description: oagen-based generator for the amzn_selling_partner Python package

scripts.sdk:check: npx oagen resolve --spec spec/open-api-spec.yaml --format json > /dev/null && echo 'Config loaded successfully'
scripts.regenerate: npm run spec:build && npm run sdk:generate && npm run spec:build -- --petstore && npm run sdk:generate -- --spec spec/petstore.yaml --output ../tests/petstore_sdk && npm run format
